title: VPN fails after password change
description: VPN rejects new password after employee password reset
resolution: Clear cached credentials and re-authenticate using the updated password

title: Outlook cannot send emails
description: Messages remain in the outbox and sending fails
resolution: Check connectivity and mailbox quota then retry

title: Laptop will not start
description: Laptop has no power indicator and will not boot
resolution: Check approved power adapter and escalate with asset ID

title: Account locked after MFA
description: User is locked out after repeated multi factor authentication attempts
resolution: Follow approved identity verification and account unlock procedure

title: WiFi connection drops
description: Wireless connection disconnects repeatedly in meeting rooms
resolution: Check access point status and collect network diagnostics

title: SAP application crashes
description: SAP closes when the user opens the finance module
resolution: Record application version and error details then escalate to Application Support

title: Suspicious email received
description: Employee received an email asking for credentials via an unknown link
resolution: Do not click the link and report to Security Operations immediately

title: Printer not responding
description: Office printer appears online but jobs remain queued
resolution: Check queue and approved printer status then contact Desktop Support

title: Mailbox full
description: User receives quota exceeded notification and messages bounce
resolution: Review mailbox quota and follow company retention policy

title: Teams audio not working
description: User cannot hear audio during online meetings
resolution: Check selected audio device and app permissions then restart Teams

title: Password reset request
resolution: Use the approved self-service password reset process

title: Internet outage in office
description: Multiple employees report internet is down
resolution: Check service status and escalate as high priority to Network Support
